reason: A browser-based DSH appearance plugin for selecting and editing background images or gradients, with separate page settings, panel translucency, typography colors, and local browser storage.

summaries.zh: 用于自定义 DSH Web 界面和轨迹页背景的插件，支持图片或渐变、裁剪、模糊、变暗、透明面板及位置调整。
summaries.en: A DSH web appearance plugin for customizing main and trajectory page backgrounds with images or gradients, cropping, blur, dimming, translucent panels, and positioning controls.

capabilities: customizes DSH web backgrounds and panel appearance
accepts uploaded images and browser-supported folder imports
crops, blurs, dims, and positions images
stores image bytes in browser IndexedDB and settings metadata in localStorage
